title: Cargo Ships Carry 24,327 Boxes With Smaller Crews
hook: Capacity hit 24,327 while crews shrank to 20.
closing: The goods you buy now depend on giant ships operated by remarkably small crews.
question: Would you crew one?

segments.say: The largest cargo ship carries 24,327 boxes, more than six times the biggest ship in 1980.
A cargo ship now reaches 400 meters, roughly half again as long as the Titanic.
A cargo crew is now 20 people, down from 34 in 1980 even as ships became far larger.
